ceiling_directive: Prove an evaluated heterogeneous cutoff-forest message algebra with state count and bit complexity bounded by 2^{O(k log(k+1))} poly(n,b,lambda), covering branching, component products, moving endpoints, and all zero-, one-, and two-vertex tags.
improvement_directive: Resolve the heterogeneous forest closure by replacing the dense k-dimensional degree table with a shared ordered-ratio operator representation, and prove that it reproduces all tagged laws in fixed-parameter bit complexity. Validate the representation on the specified heterogeneous replicated-star and private-leaf instances before extending it to general forest components.
critique: The general supplied-feedback-set result is an XP algorithm with an (nb+n+1)^{O(k)} factor, whereas fixed-parameter exact evaluation for arbitrary heterogeneous forest attachments remains explicitly open. The 6^k fixed-parameter theorem applies only when the supplied feedback set is also a vertex cover, and the replicated-star recurrence computes only one specialized core-selection probability rather than the full tagged risk library. The rational minimax certificate is downstream finite-dimensional optimization once the risk matrices are available and does not close the missing general feedback-parameter algorithm. With no evidence that the proposed rural-China conflict graph has a small vertex cover or that the ellipsoidal rule choice improves experimental performance, the delivered package is a narrow computational companion rather than a field-tier econometric contribution. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.4 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
